title: Lubbuu Qabeenyaa Kan Aangoo Gaafii Kaaste
intro: Seenaa Qur’aanaa keessatti namni qabeenyi fi beekumsi isaa sheekkoo ta’e tokko jiraata ture. Lubbuun kun faayaafi badhaadhummaa namoota ilaalan ija namaa jaamsu qabattee lafa keessaa baate, ta’us onneen isaanii of tuuluun guddate. Iccitii oduu durii Qur'aana of eeggannoo guddaa ta'e keessaa tokko, bakka guddinni qaamaa lafa qabeenya isaanii dhalche jalatti dhuma gad of deebisu waliin yeroo wal argan nu waliin ta'aa.
clues: Faaya ija nama hunda qabateen faayame lafa keessaa ba'e.
Badhaadhina bal’aa fi beekumsa gadi fagoo namoota biroo irraa adda na godhu qabadheen ture.
Ergamaan tokko gara Rabbiitti namoota waamaa yeroo dhufu, ani boonsaan aangoo isaanii gaaffii keessa galche.
Warri naannoo koo jiran tola Rabbii madda qabeenya koo miti jedhanii hasaasan.
Sabni koo guddina koo dinqisiifatee hiree koo wajjin wal fakkaatu hawwe.
Caasaan koo inni dinqisiisaan akka adabbii waaqummaatti guutummaatti lafa keessa liqimfame.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Of tuulummaadhaan aangoo raajii tokkoo gaaffii keessa galchuu

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Qilleensaa fi dalga gidduutti galaana keessatti darbadhaa
Mallattoo ta'ee gara samiitti lubbuun kaafamee

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
